items.evidence: Acceptance test passes and deep-compares every stored entry with the worker 'grade' response. Holdout: REVIEW_FOUR stored via fake-indexeddb and read back gives 4 entries preflop/flop/turn/river, actions raise/bet/check/call, recommended raise/bet/bet/call, grades correct/correct/minor/correct (the approved Block 1 correction; these are exactly the worker's values). Entry 0 is chart with null numbers; entries 1-3 are equity with finite percents (72.7/0, 55.3/0, 48.2/19) and seat 2 in opponentBasis. Across 11 completed scripted scenarios (24 decisions), every stored entry strictly equals the worker's grade response, and get() returns the same JSON.

Acceptance test passes. Holdout: the flop decision with a 29-hand snapshot stores seat 2 basis {observedHands:null,text:'typical player'}, and with a 30-hand snapshot it stores observedHands 30. Snapshots naming a folded seat (1) or seat 10 (not at the table) are ignored: the result equals the no-snapshot advice (A-5).
Acceptance test passes. Holdout: all REVIEW_FOUR entries have hinted false, and all 44 decisions from real-app play have hinted:false.
Acceptance test passes. Holdout: PREFLOP_FOLD_ONLY gives one chart entry that equals the worker's response. In the real app, hands where the user folded preflop stored 1 entry.

Acceptance test passes. Holdout: JSON round-trip strict-equals for every scenario; parseHandRecord accepts the JSON copies; grade keys are exactly grade/ruleId/marginPts. Turn entry (approved correction: margin check moved to entry 2) is aggression-margin with marginPts 5.3, equal to the worker's value.

Acceptance test covers the 8 listed inputs plus a valid entry followed by a null one, through estimateOpponentRanges, recommend, decisionRecord and the worker. Holdout: [[]], 'x', true, seat -1/Infinity/2^60/null/undefined/10.0000001, a missing seat, and a valid entry followed by 7 all throw RangeError on the flop view and through decisionRecord. The worker returns ok:false with name RangeError. Seats 10 and 1 are accepted. A duplicate seat still throws RangeError. A null entry on a preflop view does not throw (A-4).

Unit test covers all listed cases with exact error fields. Holdout: 32 more mutations are rejected with the expected field. These include decisions as an object, null or 401 entries; a null or array entry; a missing action; blind types; amounts of -4, 1.5 or missing; an unknown basis; a null ruleId on an equity entry; requiredEquityPct -1; a string equityPct; a chart entry with opponentBasis or equityPct; 10 opponentBasis entries; observedHands -1 or 2.5; a non-object basis; a non-string explanation; grade null or 'great'; marginPts '3' or NaN; hinted missing or 1; a popped entry; an empty list; a street mismatch; an amount mismatch. These boundary values parse: explanation of 2000 characters, text of 200, marginPts null, percents 0 and 100. The 0-decision BB_WALK record parses.

Unit test passes; it mutates the result and its inputs and checks nothing is shared. Holdout: userAdviceOptions() === ACTION_RANGE_ADVICE; with a snapshot it returns {opponentRanges:'actions', observedOpponents: <same array>}; ACTION_RANGE_ADVICE is not mutated. The decision-snapshot and advice-service suites pass as part of npm test.

No production path is affected: the only user-action path in src is applyUserAction, and all e2e runs pass. Only a future test that stores this fixture would hit it.
